title: Ravindra Sarode, MD | Autor | Manual MSD versión para profesionales
content: Ravindra Sarode , MD Especialidades y experiencia Clinical Pathology, Hematology, Transfusion Medicine and Hemostasis Afiliaciones Director, Division of Transfusion Medicine & Hemostasis The University of Texas Southwestern Medical Center Chief of Pathology and Medical Director The University of Texas Southwestern Clinical Laboratory Services Educación Residency: Pathology and Hematology, Post Graduate Institute of Medical Education and Research, Chandigarh, India Fellowship: Transfusion Medicine, The Blood Center of Southeastern Wisconsin, Milwaukee, WI Residency: Clinical Pathology, Albert Einstein College of Medicine/Montefiore Medical Center, Bronx, NY Medical School: Mahatma Gandhi Memorial Medical College, Indore, India Internship: Mahatma Gandhi Memorial Medical College, Indore, India Certificaciones American Board of Pathology - Clinical Pathology American Board of Pathology - Blood Banking/Transfusion Medicine Selección de premios, logros y publicaciones Presidential Award, American Society of Apheresis, 2015 Guest Editor for Hematology/Oncology Clinics of North America, Platelet Disorder issue, 2007 Vernie A. Stembridge Resident Teaching Award, UT Southwestern Medical Center, 2005 Outstanding Physician Award, University Hospital of Cleveland, 2000 Reviewer for journals, including Blood, The Lancet, Journal of Thrombosis and Hemostasis, JAMA, Transfusion, and British Journal of Hematology Over 200 articles in peer-reviewed journals and many book chapters Past President of American Society for Apheresis Co-Editor-in-Chief, Transfusion and Apheresis Science Capítulos y comentarios del manual Capítulos Medicina transfusional
